arguments.command:
cd /workspace && timeout 100 python3 -u -c "
import sys, time, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import verify
from protocol import loads as raw_loads, validate as raw_validate
for seed in range(4):
    text = open('/tmp/r%d.json'%seed).read()
    resp = open('/tmp/o%d.json'%seed).read()
    t0=time.time()
    try:
        req = raw_validate(raw_loads(text))
        c = verify.Checker(req)
        c.run(json.loads(resp))
        print(seed, 'verify ok', round(time.time()-t0,2), flush=True)
    except verify.Bad as e:
        print(seed, 'VERIFY FAIL', e, flush=True)
" 2>&1 | tail -10
